summary: Agents that turn a small organisation's messy software list into a dated, evidence-backed patch list.

zetaris.role: data layer for all four sources (synthetic inventory, CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS, NIST NVD), registered as REST tables and views and queried with SQL through the Zetaris REST API

meterless_engines.source: github.com/Meterless/Meterless at commit 1742dec, engines/world-model (Apache-2.0), vendored unmodified
features: provenance block on every patch line
memory across runs (Since the last run; kept target dates)
merge-review queue for near-duplicate KEV names
meterless_engines.test: npm run verify:engine (official conformance runner 8/8, idempotency check, --mutate check, vendored files unmodified)

meterless_nightshift.role: the only AI provider: every model call goes to Nightshift's OpenAI-compatible endpoint with a pinned Nemotron model ID, and each call's receipt (routed model, receipt ID) is logged

models.nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b: second juror; first re-decide of a row the critic sends back
models.nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b: decides jury splits; critiques contested matches; same-product check; second re-decide

nvidia.evidence: every model call in logs/trace-<run_id>.jsonl and in RunResponse.receipts carries the requested model, the routed model and the Nightshift receipt ID

sponsor_technology.cursor: not used; built with Claude Code

pre_existing_components: Meterless World Model reference engine (Apache-2.0), vendored unmodified from github.com/Meterless/Meterless at commit 1742dec
